busy.title: Printer busy
busy.hint: Another P12 program is printing right now. Wait a moment or close the other program.

unreachable.title: Printer not reachable
unreachable.hint: Is the printer off or asleep? Turn it on. Is the phone app connected? Only one host can connect at a time, so disconnect it there.

not_paired.title: Printer not paired
not_paired.hint: Pair the printer in the Windows Bluetooth settings, then run 'p12 setup'.

locked.title: File locked
locked.hint: Another P12 program is writing right now. Wait a moment and try again.

incomplete.title: Print incomplete
incomplete.hint: The connection was lost while printing (battery empty? printer off?). Check the printer and print the label again (p12 reprint last).

busy.title: COM port in use
busy.hint: Another program is holding the port (phone app, old phomemo tool, terminal). Close that program or turn the printer off and on again.

missing.title: COM port missing
missing.hint: Pair the printer in the Windows Bluetooth settings or run 'p12 setup'.

lost.title: Bluetooth connection lost
lost.hint: The printer is off or out of range. Turn it on, move closer and try again.

error.title: Print service not reachable
error.hint: The print service is not responding. Close the app, open it again and retry.

invalid.title: Invalid document
invalid.hint: The label is damaged or was created by a newer version. Check the file or create it again.

error.title: Invalid message
error.hint: The program and the print service do not match. Close all P12 programs and start them again.

missing.title: Credentials missing
missing.hint: Store the value for the secret reference (Windows Credential Manager, file or environment variable).

not_printable.title: Label cannot be printed
not_printable.hint: Fill in the required fields and check the notes in the preview.

invalid.title: Invalid value
invalid.hint: Check your input and correct it.

invalid.title: Invalid request
invalid.hint: Check your input. If the error persists, reload the page.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.hint: This item does not exist (anymore). Reload the list.

required.title: Sign-in required
required.hint: Reload the page or open the app from the tray menu.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.hint: This access is not permitted to perform the action. Use access with a suitable role.

not_allowed.title: Action not allowed
not_allowed.hint: This request is not supported here. Update the app.

conflict.title: Conflict
conflict.hint: Something changed in the meantime. Reload and try again.

too_large.title: Too large
too_large.hint: The data is too large. Use a smaller file or less content.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.hint: Wait a moment and try again.

error.title: Request failed
error.hint: Try again. If that does not help, use “Report a problem”.

token_missing.title: Token missing
token_missing.hint: Store the token for the service in the homelab settings.

not_configured.title: Service not set up
not_configured.hint: Add the service in the homelab settings.

unreachable.title: Service not reachable
unreachable.hint: Check the network and the service address, then try again.

auth_failed.title: Access denied
auth_failed.hint: Check the token or credentials for the service.

upstream.title: Service error
upstream.hint: The service returned an unexpected response. Try again later.

not_installed.title: Not installed
not_installed.hint: Updates are only available for the installed app. Install it with “Installieren.cmd” from the zip.

no_trusted_key.title: No update key
no_trusted_key.hint: This version has no trusted key. Install the new version manually.

source_invalid.title: Invalid update source
source_invalid.hint: Enter a valid source in the settings (github:owner/repo, file:folder or an https address).

source_unreachable.title: Update source not reachable
source_unreachable.hint: Check the network and try again later.

signature_invalid.title: Invalid signature
signature_invalid.hint: The update is not trusted and was discarded.

checksum_mismatch.title: Checksum mismatch
checksum_mismatch.hint: The download is damaged. Try again later.

download_failed.title: Download failed
download_failed.hint: Check the network and try again.

busy.title: Busy right now
busy.hint: A print is running or the queue is not empty. Try again later.

apply_failed.title: Update failed
apply_failed.hint: The previous version keeps running. The log has details, and “Report a problem” helps narrow it down.

unavailable.title: Barcode decoder unavailable
unavailable.hint: zxing-cpp could not be loaded (for example blocked by Windows Smart App Control). Enter the serial number by hand, printing still works.

disabled.title: Module turned off
disabled.hint: Turn it on under Settings > Modules or with “tapesmith module enable <module>”.

internal.title: Error
internal.hint: Unexpected error. Try again, or use “Report a problem”.
